what_it_checks: The six-step reopen ordering: no crossing, a crossing, and a closure-crossing shift.
derivation: Section 4.1 uses crossing from < at <= candidate. No crossing leaves candidate unchanged. A crossing shifts candidate before cell assignment and next_from. If that shift lands closed, calendar.next_open_ns supplies the resolved parent, and that snapped time is also the cell and the base for next_from.
